decisions: pi-web-access 0.45.0 to 0.46.0: kept. The code diff was read before install: new search and fetch providers (Tabstack, SearchApi, Cloudflare) that run only when a key is set and named, and an optional `fetchContent.curl` that starts the command the user configures. No new dependency, no data leaves unless configured.

cut-output re-reads: the log now tells a read of the saved file (the cut working as told) from a command run again (the waste). The first log, 16 of 38 cuts read again, did not tell them apart. The share to keep under 15 % is the rerun share; it is read with `cutStats`.
pi-lens, pi-subagents with a scout model, pi-usage: no trial yet, so no result. Each needs real tasks run with the pack switch, and none was installed.

Compaction point by role (part compaction-point): worker 80k, reviewer 70k, coordinator and chat 70k, Dispatcher 60k (L216, first try from the band table; before: 100k, 100k, 80k), set under `compaction` in pack.json; switch the part off for the 150k baseline. The week-limit weight of cache reads could not be measured: limits.json keeps only the latest percent per account, so no series exists to regress against token use. Until it is logged, judge by tokens per merged step both raw and with cache reads weighted 0.1 and 1. Keep these only if, over at least 20 merged steps on each side, tokens per merged step drop and merge rate, review findings and re-reads in the 25 turns after a compaction do not get worse. No A/B result yet.
